subject.title: fix: honor configured provider timeouts after plugin model rebuilds

question: Should maintainers land this focused terminal-normalization repair or the broader overlapping implementation at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/113721 as the canonical fix for the provider timeout/watchdog regression?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same reported user problem, while the current PR is protected by the `maintainer` label and the supplied context does not establish that either branch fully subsumes the other’s unique regression coverage.

options.title: Adopt the focused repair
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical change if the terminal model-normalization boundary is sufficient and the broader PR’s additional changes are not needed.

options.title: Adopt the broader repair
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/113721 if its extra typed-path and supporting-coverage work is required to protect all supported resolution paths.

options.title: Consolidate before landing
options.body: Move the agreed minimal coverage into one branch and close the other only after the final scope and proof are preserved.

recommendation.title: Adopt the focused repair
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical change if the terminal model-normalization boundary is sufficient and the broader PR’s additional changes are not needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The current focused implementation and its protected review state make this person the most direct available routing contact, with the overlapping PR author also relevant.
